listing.name: Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 (Geometry Wars 2 Recompiled)
listing.summary: Prepared Windows Geometry Wars 2 copy using your own matching XBLA package. Upstream owns setup, runtime replacement and portable player data; Portcove can record the ordinary native player separately from Play.

steps.title: Prepare an authorized upstream copy
steps.instruction: Use an independently obtained, authorized Windows copy and the selected upstream guide. The GPL license of the project does not cover the original game or automatically cover every bundled component: the pinned TRG launcher revision has no explicit license file. Automated acquisition needs a separate rights decision. Preserve the complete package, runtime libraries, configuration and notices in a writable folder; do not register an updater or installer. Before the first upstream startup, make separate backups of any existing Documents/geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2 profile and portable user_data/ profile; a successful upstream migration removes the legacy folder.

steps.title: Install your own matching Xbox 360 original
steps.instruction: Deliberately finish upstream setup outside Portcove using your own Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 XBLA LIVE package, title 584108FF and content type 000D0000. The extracted default.xex must be 704,512 bytes with SHA-256 6D5D9980A1D17DC74B9CCF540CEC16C2E144E7CEE3A74938E78C237B8ACEEB88. Individual container hashes can vary. The launcher installs the game into adjacent game/. A container or another Xbox title is not a substitute for this executable gate.

steps.title: Add the prepared native player
steps.instruction: Choose geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe with its containing package folder as the working folder and no arguments for ordinary Play. Its built-in launcher starts the game in the same native process. Finish setup and any update or setting that requires Restart before adding or starting a tracked session; Restart and the separate updater may replace the process. Saving launch details and Play are separate actions. Use the actual selected copy, not a guessed path.

steps.title: Preserve original and player data
steps.instruction: Upstream/player remains the only runtime-replacement owner. Preserve game/, user_data/, logs/, the executable TOML and any chosen custom roots before changing versions. Portable user_data/ contains the 584108FF profile/local scores, achievements, cache and launcher settings. Before the first upstream startup, back up the legacy Documents/geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2 profile and any portable user_data/ profile separately. When upstream migrates legacy data, it moves the legacy folder by rename, or uses a staged verified copy and then removes the legacy folder after activation; successful migration does not leave the old profile in place. A failed migration falls back to the legacy root for that run and retries on the next startup. If only legacy cleanup fails after activation, portable user_data/ stays active and the legacy folder may remain. An unwritable portable root can also fall back to the system root. --user_data_root=<folder> selects that root without migration; --cache_root can select a separate cache. Preserve every active root and the separate backups. Portcove does not own these external files or promise backup, rollback, save compatibility or deletion.

warnings: The selected release and source recipe were inspected as public metadata/source only; package contents, native launch, gameplay, real saves and update execution were not tested. Experimental Linux AppImages are a separate route.
